Our first grill after we remodeled our house almost 30 years ago was a Weber Genesis 3000.
When we moved to Florida 9 years later it came with us. We got a lot of use out of this grill. After almost 20 years of faithful service we finally had to replace it. 
We purchased an inexpensive grill that only lasted a few years. It fell apart and we were not able to use it. We had been without a grill for a few years till this new purchase. 
We recently built a paver patio in our back yard and thought it would be a great time to purchase a new grill. 
During our research we found that a lot of the grills that I considered inexpensive were not that much less expensive than a Weber and their construction was flimsy compared to Weber. 
They did not look like they could stand up to the use so instead of another inexpensive grill we decided to buy a Weber.
We have had it now for several now week and have been very happy with it.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber LP gas grill. Assembly took a little over an hour, and the instructions were clear. Weber has taken some excellent steps in protecting the burners on the Spirit II compared to their older models. The crossover tube is now protected from grease drippings with welded shields on it that are positioned between the flavorizer bars. The burners themselves run front to back, instead of side to side as my previous grill did. I do see that configuration as a minor annoyance, as when grilling over direct heat, I used to be able to use just one burners for 7 hamburger patties, where now I have to use both burners, resulting in a bit of heavier gas consumption.  This brings me to my next point. The Spirit II is not a big grill. It made sense for me though, in that I am not feeding a full family, nor throwing parties. I did invest in the optional iGrill 3 (with the lowercase ‘i’, I can only wonder if Apple was involved in the creation of it) accessory, and I hope you will too. Installation was a snap, although this amazing complement to your Weber setup will add $100 to your total cost. That’s worth it, at least to me. My only complaint about the iGrill 3 system is that it doesn’t tell you when to flip your steaks. True grillmasters may not care, but there are those of us that do. We want perfection, Weber, so please upgrade your app. Having been a Weber owner for 30 years, I can clearly see that the company has taken great strides in improvements in build quality and overall ease of use. Whether you are a grilling newbie, or a seasoned pro, the Spirit II will not disappoint.
Results.Title: Weber’s Spirit II is a solid GO!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your review! Condensation is normal to occur inside the thermometer and it isn't that uncommon. You can remove it from the lid and put it in a cup of dry rice for a day. It's only held on by a wingnut on the inside of the lid. When using your grill be sure to pre-heat it on high for 15 to 20 minutes so your grill grates are nice and hot. This way your food will stick less and less over time as your grates get seasoned. With your burners on all high your grill should reach 500-550 within 15 to 20 minutes. Our grills are designed to cook with the lid down, so be sure to not open your lid too much. If you have any issues with your grill and need assistance, be sure to reach out to our support team and we will be happy to help!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I've been a charcoal grill man my entire life, but recently with my grill (a 7 year old Charbroil) wearing out and charcoal shooting up to 8 dollars a bag I wanted to make the switch to gas.

After looking at many different sizes and models it came down to the Weber Spirit II E-210.

I must admit I was worried going into it as it did seem to be an awful lot of money for a small grill. Rest assured it's worth every single penny.

The overall quality of every piece is far superior to other models I looked at. It's also much bigger than you think it is. No, it's not going to grill for a party of 20 in one go, but it's more than enough for our family of four and no doubt could handle a party of 10 to 12 with relative ease.

The temperature control is what is so amazing about it. I've waited to write this review until I had at least 12 cookouts on it.

You'll be used to where your temperature ranges are by the time you get 4 or 5 cookouts under your belt. On mine, the second to the lowest setting on both knobs gives you a perfect 300 degrees for slower cooking. Up one mark takes it to 325. The half way marker is a perfect 400 degrees.

I'm sure that may very from grill to grill just a bit, but fact is once you get the temperature where you want it, just look where your knobs are set. It will be that way every single time you use it. It makes it very, very easy to have the same results every time.

The grills are also great. I, oddly, follow the directions and there's no stick at all on them. They're fantastic! I actually use a plastic spatula so I don't scratch the ceramic coating off.

I've cooked burgers, chicken, pork chops, ribs and steaks and never had anything stick.

It heats up quickly too thanks to its smaller size so you don't waste so much gas like you do on a larger model. In 10 to 12 minutes you're at 400 degrees no problem.

It's just a really, really well made and well engineered grill.

The only thing I'm yet to really try on it is off heat slow cooking, but I'll cross that bridge when I get to it.

If you're on the fence about buying this grill wondering if it'll be enough and if it's worth it, climb on down on this side and buy it. You'll be very glad you did.
Results.Title: Best grill I have ever owned.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The Weber Spirit II E210 has 2 burners (E310 has 3 burners and $100 more). We have a small family, so the 2 burner works great! Heats up fast. Worked well using one burner for making a few burgers. Gets nice and hot. Easy to clean grates. I bought it because other brands kept breaking. Weber has a great reputation for being reliable and also by work of mouth. Only con was you have to put together the entire frame. Took 3 hours and one of the pieces wasn’t molded correctly which was odd! Once it was done it was well worth it! Suggestion: have the store out it together and take it home!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText:
This unit will make you look like a BBQ expert. 
It cooks steak, chicken, fish, vegetables all perfectly. 
No burning, no flare ups, no drama just perfectly done every time.
Do yourself a big favor and move up to this unit. You will never buy a cheep BBQ again.
Only miss is the IGrill feature. Totally valueless feature, notice no review mentions it at all.
Please give us a side burner option that comes as a packaged deal. That would rock.
Results.Title: Wonderfull cooking machine

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText: We met a couple in Costa Rica over the winter whose son works for Weber. They raved about their BBQ's.  We were in the market so I looked. We bought a small Spirit !! model and it is perfect for the two of us. We BBQ all year around. More than happy.  Great value , heats up so fast and easy to maintain a constant temperature. Best money ever spent for a BBQ. Buy one. You will not regret it.
Results.Title: Excellent value

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: My last Weber lasted 22 years and still started seamlessly.  It just rusted out in the legs.  I don’t think this is built as well.  It works fine but it is “stainless“ looking And gets dirty quickly in addition to getting very hot in Florida afternoon sun.  I hope it stands up to the quality of my old one but as soon as I received it I needed a new side table that was broke.  Weber sent me a new one quickly, but I had hoped it would be made with better quality materials. Time will tell.

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.

44020001.Description: Open your door to the world of grilling with the sleek Spirit II E-210 gas grill. Welcome to the Weber family.
